prompt_text.description: The text displayed as the command prompt in the websploit console.

modules.description: List of modules available in the websploit database. Items are flat maps of module properties.

modules.items.description: Properties for a single module item in the modules list. Note: Type is 'object' in schema logic but represented as flat fields in the list definition above for Jinja iteration compatibility.

modules.items.name.description: The name identifier of the module.

modules.items.description.description: A short description of the module's purpose.

allow_updates.description: Whether the update command is enabled. Debian packages typically disable this to avoid apt conflicts.

require_root.description: Whether the tool requires root privileges to run.
